name: B10-0099/2024 (PPE) – The case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
title: Resolution on the case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Türkiye for sentencing journalist Bülent Mumay to 20 months in prison over social media posts, and for blocking news about the upheld sentence. It calls on Türkiye to release him and other detained journalists. It asks the European Union to consider sanctions against those who persecute journalists, and to monitor their trials more closely. It warns that Türkiye's poor human rights record could harm its relations with the EU.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It concerns Bülent Mumay, other jailed journalists, and Türkiye's government.
- The EU and Türkiye are now asked to act on these calls.
